reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Zyxel Device
reconfigure.description: Update the connection details without removing and re-adding the integration.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: The AP rejected the stored credentials. Enter the current SSH password.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to device. Check IP address and network.
error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Check username and password.

intervals.title: Refresh intervals
intervals.description: How often each group is refreshed. Which data belongs to which group is set separately, in "Data assignment".

data_groups.title: Data assignment
data_groups.description: Choose which refresh group (Fast / Slow / Daily) each family of data belongs to. Defaults match the recommended split; change any of them freely.

mikrotik.title: MikroTik hostname resolver
mikrotik.description: Optional. Resolves device hostnames from MikroTik DHCP leases - fully decoupled from the Zyxel AP connection (its own connection, its own cycle, its own cache).

security.title: Security - SSH fingerprints
security.description: SSH host key fingerprints are remembered on first connection (Trust On First Use) and checked on every connection afterwards. Current Zyxel fingerprint: {zyxel_fingerprint}. Current MikroTik fingerprint: {mikrotik_fingerprint}. Only reset a fingerprint if you know the key change is legitimate (device replaced/factory reset) - otherwise it could indicate someone intercepting the connection.
